concerns.text: The test uses a hardcoded UUID (0bcb9d29-ad04-4c30-8448-e3cbacf70c4f). While transactional rollback prevents permanent database pollution, generating a random UUID is generally safer to avoid any potential key conflicts in shared environments.

In TaskService.java, the log statement level was updated from INFO to WARN to align with PR reconciliation changes, but it does not use the telemetry-specific bracket prefix used in PR #0. Standardizing the log format across these reconciliation classes is recommended.
